name: Walt Disney

sources.title: The Walt Disney Company Form 10-K for fiscal year ended September 27, 2025 (Segment information note)

branches.name: Sports
brands: ESPN DTC (ESPN Select / ESPN Unlimited, ex-ESPN+)

notes: Fiscal years end on the Saturday nearest 30 September (FY2023 = 30 Sep 2023, FY2024 = 28 Sep 2024, FY2025 = 27 Sep 2025). All three years taken from the FY2025 10-K segment note (Entertainment / Sports / Experiences structure, in place since Q4 FY2023; FY2023 figures as presented in that latest 10-K). Segment revenue includes intersegment amounts; 'Other' revenue = intersegment eliminations. Profit total = total segment operating income as presented by Disney (the company does not report a GAAP operating income line); therefore 'Other' profit is 0. Below segment OI, Disney deducts corporate and unallocated shared expenses (-1,147 / -1,435 / -1,646), restructuring and impairment charges (-3,836 / -3,595 / -819), equity loss of the India JV (FY2025 -202), TFCF and Hulu acquisition amortization (-1,998 / -1,677 / -1,576), other income (expense) net and net interest, giving income before taxes of 4,769 / 7,569 / 12,003. Star India was deconsolidated on 14 Nov 2024 (JioStar JV, 37% equity stake) - affects Entertainment and Sports comparability. ESPN is ~80% owned; National Geographic 73%; Hong Kong Disneyland 48% and Shanghai Disney Resort 43% (consolidated).
